scope: Real-image multilabel native SeaClear object presence research; not full-schema Model 1, defect detection, safety clearance or segmentation
attribution: Duras, Ilioudi, Wolf, Palunko and De Schutter (2024), SeaClear v1, doi:10.4121/4f1dff25-e157-4399-a5d4-478055461689.v1
encoder: torchvision resnet18 IMAGENET1K_V1; fixed general-vision transfer features, no prior underwater checkpoint
preprocessing: Full image resized to 224x224, ImageNet channel normalization; no center crop; labels are presence of native COCO categories
selection: Highest mean validation macro average precision across the two seeds; ensemble selected seeds. Only categories with >=20 training positives supported. Unsupported categories listed explicitly.
threshold_selection: After checkpoint matrix lock, choose one global threshold from 0.1,0.2,...,0.9 maximizing calibration micro-F1. This is not probability calibration or guaranteed risk control.
heldout_policy: Feature extraction uses no fitted data-dependent preprocessing and never trains on heldout labels. Site-disjoint validation/calibration/test; deduplicate exact image hashes before training. Evaluate the selected ensemble on test once, after locking all candidates and threshold.
stopping_rule: Three preregistered two-candidate rounds. Report bounded feature-head plateau only if final two rounds do not improve validation mAP by 0.005, otherwise budget exhausted; neither means no further software improvements exist.
